description: Extend the Chinook database schema to support mood tagging. Create two new tables: 'Mood' (MoodId INTEGER PK, Name VARCHAR(50)) and a junction table 'TrackMood' (TrackId INTEGER, MoodId INTEGER, composite PK, Foreign Keys to Track and Mood). Populate 'Mood' with 'Energetic' (ID 1), 'Focus' (ID 2), and 'Melancholy' (ID 3). Finally, perform a bulk insert to tag all 'Rock' tracks as 'Energetic' (MoodId=1) and all 'Jazz' tracks as 'Focus' (MoodId=2). Save the database file to persist changes.
